faqs.question: Can I get direct admission at DIATM?
faqs.answer: Yes, Candidates get direct admission at Durgapur Institute of Advanced Technology and Management  in MCA. The college offers admission to MCA based on last qualifying exam score. Further, for other courses the college offers entrance-based admission. To get admission to MCA, candidates are required to pass graduation degree in a relevant field from a recognised board with 50% aggregate.

college_info.intro:
Durgapur Institute of Advanced Technology and Management comprises 8 departments, including Applied Science & Humanities, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science & Engineering, Chemical Engineering, and others. MBA and BTech are the popular courses offered at the institute.
DIATM Durgapur offers a full-time, four-year BTech programme at the UG level. The BTech programmes offered at the institute cover core courses in the areas of Computer Sciences & Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, and Chemical Engineering. admission_process.title: Durgapur Institute of Advanced Technology and Management Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Durgapur Institute of Advanced Technology and Management admission 2025 is open for all the courses. The college offers one UG and two PG courses such as BTech, MBA and MCA, respectively. Admission to all the courses is entrance-based except MCA.Durgapur Institute of Advanced Technology and Managementconducts the application process online. To get admission, candidates must apply and appear for the entrance exam accepted by the college.

Further, for admission to MCA, candidates must fill out the enquiry form to grab the application form. Read the complete article to know more information related to DIATM admission, along with course eligibility and selection criteria:

Durgapur Institute of Advanced Technology and Management offers BTech, MBA and MCA at UG and PG levels. Admission to BTech and MBA is entrance-based. This includes appearing and applying for one entrance exam, WBJEE, JEE Main followed by counselling for BTech, and appearing in MAT/JEMAT, followed by counselling for an MBA. Further for MCA courses college offers merit-based admission. The college is affiliated withMaulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology (MAKAUT), Hence, students are awarded with a MAKAUT degree on completion of their respective courses. Check the below table forDurgapur Institute of Advanced Technology and Management courseeligibility & selection criteria in the following table:
Eligibility
Selection Criteria
Class 10 and Class 12 or equivalent examination with 45% marks in Science Group (Physics, Chemistry & Mathematics)
JEE MAIN/WBJEE+ Counselling
BTech Lateral
Diploma in Engineering /Technology
Graduation degree with Class 10 and Class 12 from a recognised university/institute
Graduation degree in a relevant field from a recognised board with 50% aggregate
Merit-Based
90% of Seats are filled up from WBJEE through centralized counselling.
10% of Seats are filled up from JEE Main through centralized counselling.

Durgapur Institute of Advanced Technology and Management admission process is a multi-step process that includes application, appearance in the selection rounds, application process, and document verification. A step-by-step Durgapur Institute of Advanced Technology and Management admission process that students need to follow is as follows:
STEP 1: DIATM Application Process

Durgapur Institute of Advanced Technology and Management offers entrance-based admission to BTech and MBA. For registration to BTech and MBA, candidates are required to apply on the official website of the respective entrance exams. Further, for admission to MCA, candidates are required to fill out the enquiry form or directly call the admission cell to get the application form.
Step 3: DIATM Selection Rounds

Durgapur Institute of Advanced Technology and Management shortlists candidates for MBA and BTech based on the entrance exam. The college considers entrance exams such as WBJEE, JEE Main, JELET and MAT/JEMAT for admission toBTech, BTech lateral and MBA, respectively. Further, the college offers merit-based admission to MCA.
STEP 4: Document Verification & Payment of Admission Fee

Candidates who are shortlisted as per the course eligibility & selection rounds must submit theDIATM feefor all courses. Following this, candidates are required to go through the document verification and are intimated about the date of commencement of the classes

reviews.review_heading: One can try this college.
reviews.review_text: Very good facilities and campus is so beautiful. There are medical camps on campus. There are many hostels available. Hostel food is too good. I think there are two canteens available near campus. Sports ground is too long.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied because of placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of my college is very broad and large, as it is part of the Rahul Foundation. It has many buildings, including diploma, medical, and mini-engineering colleges. Our college, Durgapur Institute of Advanced Technology and Management, has a wide layout. Wi-Fi connection is available in each and every block. There are many labs, classrooms, and a library provided for every subject. The language section in the library is extensive.

reviews.review_heading: My Opinion of My college .
reviews.review_text: First of all, this college campus is so big because of many courses it offers. Like medical, nursing law, BBA BCA, etc. Faculty members are so good. Very helpful and doubt-solving faculty members are their. big library in my college has something like 30000 books in their.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure & bad placement scenario.
reviews.review_text: The faculty members of the mechanical engineering branch are very helpful and supportive to there branch students as well as to others. The infrastructure of our college is good as compared with other colleges infrastructure. The quality of the facilities in our hostels is moderate.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely amazing because of faculty and good placement.
reviews.review_text: Our college's facilities and infrastructure are very good. In our whole college, there will be Wi-Fi and we also have labs for every subject and each computer lab is equipped with air conditioning. The classroom is also good and we also have a library where we can read books and withdraw books by using our library card.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissatisfied because of bad placement scenario, really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure available in our college is very good compared to other colleges. We have Wi-Fi, labs with AC, good classrooms, and a library. The quality of the facilities in our hostel is moderate compared to other colleges. The fee structure is very affordable.

reviews.review_heading: A review of  Durgapur Institute of Advanced Technology and Management.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure in my department are average. Unfortunately, Wi-Fi is not available at the college. Labs are in good condition, classrooms are well-maintained, and the library has a good collection of books. Hostel facilities include Wi-Fi, but the food quality in the canteen is not satisfactory. Medical facilities are good, and prompt action is taken in case of accidents. Sports and games like cricket, badminton, running, and chess are conducted.

reviews.review_heading: Good Campus, Placements are not that much good, Good infrastructure and faculty members are okay.
reviews.review_text: In our college, campus is good and well maintained. Infrastructure is also good for all branches. There are Labs for each department, Library, Mechanical Workshop etc. Wi- Fi is also available there. There are canteens, playgrounds, a temple and a hospital also. If I talk about hostel, everything is fine except the food.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Durgapur Institute of Advanced Technology and Management.
reviews.review_text: Our campus is spacious and full of greenery. It has beautiful gardens. There are two big playgrounds for outdoor games. Wi-Fi facility is provided 24x7 in the hostel.  Food quality is good. Our college has two canteens and medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Teachers at our college are less experienced.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facility is not so good but Wi-Fi and an indoor games room are available. The hostel also has good security. The food items served in the hostels are not good. The hostel fee is approximately Rs.30,000 per semester. There are always two or three wardens available in a hostel. The classroom atmosphere is pleasant.

reviews.review_heading: This is a good college. So take admission.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good and up to mark. The space is clean with a canteen and hygienic washrooms. Overall college is good. Everything is well maintained and the college had the necessary infrastructure facilities and equipment. They do not have to change something.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with this college, many things need to improve, and placements are not good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this college plays a vital role in the development as the students were now focusing on the laboratories, classrooms, etc., while selecting a college. It was important that this colleges had very good infrastructure with advanced laboratories equipped with state of the art equipment, etc.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good placements, infrastructure, and faculty.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is quite good, and the hostel food is also good. Canteen facilities are available here. The food quality is awesome, and there are different hostels for boys and girls. Rooms are suitable. Many precautions are being taken after the pandemic season.

reviews.review_heading: It provides good facilities and faculty members teaching are also good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good. So, students will hope for much better in the future. The building is big, and facilities like a canteen, etc., are available. So I would recommend students to take admision in this college.

reviews.review_heading: I am not satisfied because of its teachers, placements, good infrastructure, and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are good in this college. Wi-Fi is available 24X7. In the hostel, laboratories have good or quality equipment. The classrooms are big and clean. Our hostel facilities are good and everything is available. The hostel size is good and faculty members are supportive. The environment of this college is clean.

paragraphs: Cluster University Srinagar admissionsare entrance-based. The university offers admission throughCUET-UGandCUET-PGfor UG and PG programmes, respectively.Cluster Universityoffers courses at UG and PG levels in multiple streams such as Engineering, Science, Arts, etc. through various colleges. Candidates who wish to apply for any of the UG or PG courses can apply online on the university website.

Cluster University offers courses in full-time mode. The university offers more than 15 courses in various specialisations at UG and PG levels. Below are the keyCluster University Srinagar admissionhighlights:

Cluster University offers admission to all the courses based on entrance exam scores. Candidates are first required to qualify the accepted exam followed by admission at the university. The basic eligibility to apply for any of the UG programmes of CUS is Class 12 whereas, graduation is required to apply for PG programmes. Below are popularCluster University Srinagar coursesalong with their eligibility and selection criteria:

There are limited seats in Cluster University for each programme. Candidates must fulfil both selection and eligibility requirements to get a seat in the university. Aspirants need to pay the course fee defined for each course to confirm their admission. Below areCluster University feesand intake for popular courses:
Note:This information is sourced from official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change.

Admissions at Cluster University begins with the registration for CUET-UG or CUET-PG exams. As a participating university, admissions through all the courses are through CUET-UG and PG exams. Below are the steps to get a seat in Cluster University Srinagar:
Step 1: Cluster University Application Process 2025

The mode of application is online. Candidates are first required to apply for CUET-UG for UG programmes and CUET-PG for PG courses. The CUET-UG application fee for General is INR 1,000 for up to three subjects. Candidates applying for CUET-PG need to pay an application fee of INR 1,200 for up to two subjects.
Step 2: Selection

Once the registration is over, candidates need to appear for the respective entrance exam. The university considers CUET-UG and CUET-PG scores for UG and PG programmes, respectively. Once the results are out, candidates need to participate in the counselling round.
Step 3: Counselling & Fee Payment

During counselling registration, candidates need to provide their college and course preferences. The university might also open registration after the announcement ofCUET resultsfor admission confirmation. Aspirants need to pay course fee to confirm their seat in the university.

faqs.answer: Yes, Cluster University offers two-year MBA course divided into four semesters. CUS accepts CUET-PG score for admission to MBA programme. Aspirants who have passed graduation with at least 55% aggregate (50% aggregate for reserved category) can apply for Cluster University Srinagar MBA.

faqs.question: Who is eligible to apply for Cluster University Srinagar MBA?
faqs.answer: Aspirants who have passed bachelor's degree with at least 55% aggregate or equivalent (50% aggregate for reserved category) can apply for Cluster University Srinagar MBA programme. Candidates must hold the documents proving their eligibility for verification at the time of admission. Besides, candidates must also qualify CUET-PG for admission to MBA programme.

faqs.question: Does Cluster University accept CUET score?
faqs.answer: Yes, Cluster University Srinagar accepts CUET-UG score for admission to UG courses. For PG programmes, the university considers CUET-PG score. Cluster University is one of the participating universities of CUET. Candidates need to appear for the entrance exam and fulfil the course-specific eligibility criteria to get admission in the preferred programme.

faqs.question: Is there any entrance exam for Cluster University?
faqs.answer: Yes, Cluster University considers CUET-UG score for UG programmes. Admission to PG programmes is based on CUET-PG score. CUET UG and CUET PG are all-India level entrance exams conducted in computer-based mode. The exams are conducted once in a year in different cities. Once the exam results are out, candidates need to register for the counselling round. The final selection will be completely based on the performance of the candidates in the entrance exam.

faqs.question: Which college comes under Cluster University?
faqs.answer: Cluster University offers UG and PG courses through five colleges. Below are list of the colleges under CUS:Abdul Ahad Azad Memorial Degree CollegeAmar Singh CollegeGovt College For WomenInstitute of Advanced Studies in EducationSri Pratap College

faqs.question: Can I join Cluster University directly?
faqs.answer: No, candidates wishing to get admission in Cluster University need to first fill out the CUET-UG and CUET-PG application form followed by appearing for the respective exam. The university offers admission to CUS courses based on CUET score. Once the CUET results are out, candidates will need to participate in the counselling round. Aspirants will also need to register for admission on the official website of the university for final selection.

individual_reviews.title: The worst part in our college is that teachers judge students based on their branches.

Students can choose these courses to embark on their careers in the field of Engineering, IT & Software, Business & Management Studies. individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: 2015-2019 batch student review.

content.Placements: More than 60% of students are placed in various companies. The highest salary package was 25k, the lowest was14k, and average was 18k. Top companies like TCS, Hyundai and some start up companies and some well known companies like Caparo are some of the recruiting companies that are the students placed in our college.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure are nice in college campus. Hostels are provided for both boys and girls. They were separated for both genders. Hostel foods are not bad but average. Canteen were well maintained and foods are neatly prepared and good. Sports like cricket, kabaddi, foot ball and some indoor games like Chess, carrom.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2016
individual_reviews.title: I'm absolutely dissatisfied because of the infrastructure and the teaching skills.

content.Placements: Placements in college were very poor. Maximum students got placed in BPOs and for data entry based work. Core companies and companies from other fields don't recruit students from our college. It is very difficult to find jobs in other sectors.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college was a little poor. Laboratories were good, and the lab staff were friendly. Classrooms and surroundings were clean, but the college had old furniture. Bus facility provided in the college was good. Basically, the fee structure was not worthy. The playgrounds for sports were very poor. The campus also had a gym which was very good.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2018
individual_reviews.title: Its a good college with having all the facilities in it.

content.Placements: We have placed in an good company and we have placed more than 50 percentage of students. The have given 15 k as an the highest salary and 10k as a the lowest salary. Sanmina, wipro, life insurance, blue infamative solution, intelinet these are the companies visited.
content.Infrastructure: We have a good labs for all the department. Having one common libertary. And having 6 liberay for each department. Having good and hygienic food has prepared in canteen. Also we have hostels for boya ans girls. We have problems on the rest room and it is solved immediately.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: The college has good infrastructure with enormous facilities.

content.Placements: Statistics of placements keep decreasing year by year, creating huge competition between us. In 2022, the top companies like Fargo, Concentrix, Capgemini, Axis, ICICI, and Muthoot Finance showed their participation in drives with 4.8 CTC as the highest package.
content.Infrastructure: The college was built in a vast circular area, with enormous facilities. The facilities, such as network connectivity and power supplies, are transmitted in a continuous mode. The medical emergencies and other facilities are readily available, and transport facilities are arranged at an affordable fee structure.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: It has good faculty and curriculum for all courses. It is a nice college with good infrastructure.

content.Placements: 82% of students got placed from our previous batch. The highest package is 4 LPA. The lowest package is 3 LPA. TCS and Caparo are the major companies recruiting at our college. A software developer is the top role offered in the computer science course.
content.Infrastructure: All basic facilities are available in our college. In the laboratory, Wi-Fi and AC are installed for students. Canteen food is of good quality, but the cost of the food is high. Yearly, once sports day is conducted. Medical facilities are also available.

placements.overview:
Madhav University was founded in 2014. It is a private university and is located in Rajasthan. Madhav University courses are offered to students at the UG, PG and Certificate levels. The institute is approved by PCI and NCTE and offers courses in both Full Time and Part Time modes. Madhav University offers a total of 150 courses in streams such as Engineering, Medicine & Health Sciences, Business & Management Studies, IT & Software, Accounting & Commerce and Mass Communication & Media. Some of the popular courses offered at the institute are B.E. / B.Tech, M.E./M.Tech, MBA/PGDM, Executive MBA/PGDM and B.Sc. and the total seat intake for the available courses is 1630. These courses are offered to students across several specialisations such as Agriculture, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Botany and Business Analytics. Further, the fee for all these courses ranges between INR 6,500 to 7,15,000. Apart from this, the Madhav University campus has a state-of-the-art infrastructure with all the advanced facilities.

Q. How many courses are offered by Apex Professional University?

A. Madhav University offers 313 courses in Arts, Commerce, Management, Science and Technology, Engineering, Law, Pharmacy and Education, and so on.

overview_faqs.question: Is Computer Engineering a good choice for career?
overview_faqs.answer: Yes, CSE (full form Computer Science and Engineering) is a good career choice if you are aspiring for a good salary package as a fresher. A Computer Engineering graduate's average salary in India is approx. INR 6 lakh and higher. Also, owing to the exponential rise in AI & ML concept), CSE course gradutes have got a competitive job market and abundant opportunities for career growth.

overview_faqs.question: What do Electrical Engineering professionals do?
overview_faqs.answer: Electrical Engineering professionals are engineering jack of all trades, as they make use of their knowledge of Physics and Mathematics along with computer programming skills to develop intricate circuit systems. These circuit boards run electrical signals to and from electrical components to accomplish everything from a mundane computer startup to controlling absolute power and precision of a rocket going out of earth's atmosphere.Know more about -Electrical Engineering Courses

individual_reviews.title: Our college is good in terms of education.

review_summary.college_name: Vatel Hotel and Tourism Business School Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor in Hotel Management (BHM) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with faculty members and the good campus life. You can learn new things every day.

content.Placements: Around 85-90% of the students were placed from our college. Top recruiters were Taj, Oberoi, JW Marriott, Raddison, etc. All the students got their internships. Top roles offered are being in events as heads, managing the college events, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Everything is above average in our university. Wi-Fi is not available everywhere, but there is good network connectivity. I am a day scholar, so I don't know about the hostel.
content.Faculty: Teachers in our college are very much helpful and supportive. Even teachers supported us during the covid time. The course curriculum is relevant to make students industry-ready. Semester exams are a bit difficult but if you study thoroughly in classes you could get good marks. The pass percentage is 70%.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor in Hotel Management (BHM) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with the good infrastructure and facilities provided by the college.

content.Placements: About 80-90% of the students from our course got placed from college. The starting salary package offered ranges from 2 LPA - 3 LPA. Top recruiting companies like Taj Hotel, Oberoi, The Leela Ambience, The Westin Hotel, Crowne Plaza, etc., visit our college for placements. Almost 100% of the students from our course got an internship. Our college also gives a chance to do an internship in France.
content.Infrastructure: Offices, the foundation of the grounds, labs, study halls, and Wi-Fi facilities are pleasant here. The library, cafeteria, and play areas are also available. Food served in the flask is additionally decent. The group and nature of the grounds are pleasant.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor in Hotel Management (BHM) - Batch of 2014
individual_reviews.title: Love the college Life alot.

content.Placements: They have a good placements in the top hotels and almost all the students got the jobs in star rated hotels. Few of them are also in other countries. We also had a great internships in the hotels and college helped us for arranging extra internships.
content.Infrastructure: Ansals have a huge building with a beautiful surroundings. They are all the different facilities in the campus. Proper manner classrooms and cleaned campus Labs have all the facilities of equipments. Library have a huge and a good study materials.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor in Hotel Management (BHM) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: Our college is good only to get an internship.

content.Placements: About 40% of the students from our course got placed. Top recruiting companies like Leela and Taj hotel visit our campus for placements. Our course is good. Our college just thinks about money, but not about the career of the students. The internship provided by the college is good.
content.Infrastructure: Labs are good, but there are no important instruments for the students. The campus is not good.
content.Faculty: Staff members in our college are not good, and our college doesn't think about students. Teachers in our college are helpful, but the dean is not helpful. They just think about the money. I suggest you do not join this college.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor in Hotel Management (BHM) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: It is not a good thing to have 75% attendance criteria. Otherwise, there is not an issue.

content.Placements: Approximately 50% of the students of our course get the opportunity to attend placements. ITC Taj, The Leela, etc., visit our college for placements. Most of the students went to France to do internships in 5-star hotels. You get the opportunity to work in a 5-star hotel. Front office department or HR team roles are offered, and you can also work in the kitchen department.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities provided by our college are good, and the Wi-Fi facility is available in every department. Restaurants are well maintained, and the kitchen department is also well maintained. Rules are strictly followed in the kitchen, and medical facilities are also good. The food available in the mess is average.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Great course with helpful teachers, good crowd, fun fests, and strong technical learning.

content.Placements: Around 60-70 percent of students from my course got placed. The highest package is 51 LPA, the average is around 10 LPA, and the lowest is about 4 LPA. Top recruiting companies include Amazon, Deloitte, Infosys, TCS, and Wipro. Around 40 percent of students got internships, mostly in companies like TCS, Infosys, and small startups. The top roles offered are Software Developer, Data Analyst, and Web Developer. However, most good placements are grabbed by students with strong skills and personal projects, not because of college support.
content.Infrastructure: The college offers good infrastructure and facilities for students. Classrooms are clean, spacious, and equipped with smart boards. The computer labs have proper systems and internet access for practical work. Wi-Fi is available across the campus and works fairly well. The library is well-maintained with a good collection of academic books and digital resources. Hostel facilities are decent with regular maintenance, though sometimes water issues occur. Mess food is average but hygienic, and the canteen provides decent options. Medical support is available on campus, and sports facilities like a gym, football ground, and badminton court help balance student life.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good placements last year and great faculty .

content.Placements: The placements are above average, as last year 88 percent got placed in CSE, which is really good. The highest package was 51 lacs at Microsoft, and the lowest was 6.5, and the average package was 12 lacs for the CSE branch and 9 lacs overall. Top companies like Microsoft, Accenture, etc., come for campus placements. Software engineer, etc., are the roles offered.
content.Infrastructure: The course here is good, but the 1st year is a little hectic, but after the 2nd semester, we get plenty of time to focus on other activities. The faculty members are very intelligent here and teach very well. Infrastructure is also fine; the labs are clean and equipped with good machines.

content.Infrastructure: It has IIT-level labs for all the information technology branches, well-equipped with all the instruments you need for any course. It also has an e-library with many desktops, a girls' college with good infrastructure and food, and good security.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied with BIT Mesra faculty and placements.

content.Placements: The placement record at BIT Mesra is excellent with almost 90 percent of students getting placed. Top companies like Google, Microsoft and Deloitte hire from this college along with the usual suspects like Infosys, TCS and Wipro. Overall, this college is a great environment to grow in life.

review_summary.college_name: Doon Group of Colleges Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Agriculture - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Doon's memory of college time.

content.Placements: Students in the agriculture stream get a minimum package, but about 20 students were selected for placement in agriculture companies. The government also provides internships in different agricultural fields. This college is good for agriculture and some other courses.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel facilities for both boys and girls are very good. In the hostel, there is a playground for different types of games like badminton, volleyball, football, cricket, etc. There are two big libraries in the college for the agriculture course. A canteen is also there.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Faculty are too good and provide better quality of education .

content.Placements: As a medical student, we have a placement of 100% package, which depends on various hospitals, mostly Max and Indresh. Roles offered are junior physiotherapist and medical lab technology; we can also set up private clinical practices for increasing our capacity.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are well-equipped with beds and everything; labs are well-equipped with models and other things. Medical labs are well-equipped with microscopes and other high-end facilities that a student can use and a well-equipped library with journals and magazines.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: An Honest Review on the College.

content.Placements: There are 30-50 students in a class per year. The yearly fees are around 65,000. There is no internship available in the college, and you can opt for any hospital according to your preference and likeness. Admission can be done through online or offline mode.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is poor, and the campus is not so big when compared to other colleges or universities. A library is available, but it is also not so big, with fewer books, and the books are not updated so far from what I remember. Hostels are provided, and buses are available for students, which is a plus point.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Agriculture - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: All about the Doon PG College of Agriculture Science And technology

content.Placements: Overall 10% students were placed in our course. Approximately 4 lakh was the average package offered in our course. Fertilizer companies like Ifco offered job in our course. 15-20% students got internship from our course some below average fertilizer and seed companies. Sales manager posts are offered in our course.
content.Infrastructure: Wifi facilities and infrastructure are good in hostel also have wifi fecilities,24/7 current availability, good water availability. Also central library and modern class room with tv and projector provided by the college. Hostel food is average not so good, every year annual sports are organized by the college and cricket field, basketball field and badminton court available in hostel.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Botany - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Fees is affordable than any other college.

content.Placements: In our campus, 4th semester passed out students are eligible for campus placement. After passing the 4th semester, various companies like Syngenta, Baayer, Agro Chemical, and various seed companies and agriculture-related companies visit the campus and select the students through the interview process. Semester marks are also very helpful for getting those jobs. But the package of those companies is not good enough. The maximum package is 3 lakhs. But it is very difficult to achieve. Mainly, salesman posts are provided by them. 40 percent of students can get a placement in those companies.

individual_reviews.title: Good, the faculty members are good, and the placements are good.

content.Placements: I am from the Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) batch at A J Institute of Engineering and Technology (AJIET). Around 95 percent of students from the ECE batch were placed during the placement season. The highest package offered was 10 LPA, the lowest was 2 LPA, and the average was around 4-5 LPA. About 80% of students secured internships with companies like Bosch, Intel, TCS, Infosys, and other startups. Top roles included Embedded System Engineer, VLSI Design Engineer, Software Developer, IoT Developer, and Testing Engineer.

reviews.review_heading: Honest review of ajiet Bangalore.
reviews.review_text: I won't rate the infrastructure of the campus much as, it is full of buildings. Besides, the environment is not much of a nature friendly. reviews.review_heading: Review of A.J. Institute of Engineering and Technology.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides good facilities. The food served in the canteen is good.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides very good facilities.
reviews.review_text: Our college has 7 libraries. It is very huge. Every lab contains around 300 computers and has a very good network. Our canteen is very good. It provides delicious food. All chefs are very good.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college for students to take admission.
reviews.review_text: Our college has the best infrastructure. There are well-designed labs, a good library with more than 10,000 books, and a huge hostel for students. Computer labs are provided for studies.

reviews.review_heading: I am dissatisfied by the fee structure but other things were good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college was good. It is a new college located in the middle of the Bangalore city. Our college has good labs and high Wi-Fi network and library. Classrooms and hygienic canteen facilities are provided.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with this college because of its placements, faculty members, and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good compared to other colleges. Our college is Wi-Fi enabled. We have a computer lab. The food served in the hostel is good and hygienic. The hostel facilities are good.

reviews.review_heading: I am dissatisfied with the college.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is so good but the college doesn't have a proper campus. Hostels have good infrastructure but the food offered is bad. There is no proper road even a road which is there is not maintained properly. When it rains we have to walk by the water and drainage is there just near to road which smells so bad. Its so hard to walk by this road.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has good infrastructure, facilities, and qualified lectures.
reviews.review_text: In our college, there are many facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, modern classrooms, a sports room, and a gym. Very good food is served in our canteen and hostel. Quality is also good and we love it. Medical facilities are not provided. But first-aid service and ambulance are avialable.

reviews.review_heading: One of the upcoming top colleges in near future. (Great placements and great faculty) .
reviews.review_text: Very good quality of food, well maintained canteens, consists of 2 canteens for the students, and separate 2 canteens for the girls and boys hostel. There are so many options available, you will get all the main dishes like fried rice, noodles, sandwiches and so much more. Food is available on the meal time basis i.e. Breakfast, lunch, snacks etc.

reviews.review_heading: I've heard that we gave good placement which depends on our talents and skills and so.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is fast and our water is not that clean that one thing should be purified. About the lab, we have good facilities and if we miss the lab we have one last chance to complete it. Canteen is quite a mess but it's okay it's natural to have but the problem is we only have 1 canteen and one food court for 1800 students.

individual_reviews.title: Sri Shivani MBA Management is one of the finest colleges in Karimnagar.

content.Placements: My batch is 2016-2019. About 50% of the students from our course got placed. The highest salary offered here is Rs. 25,000 per month, and the lowest salary offered is Rs. 12,000 per month. HDFC Bank, ICICI and MNCs are the top recruiters for our course. The top role offered in our course is HR. The highest salary package offered in our course is 3.5 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered is 1.5 LPA. About 30% of the students from our course got internships. In our college, placements are very good.
content.Infrastructure: In our college, there is a free Wi-Fi facility and bus facility for village students. Labs are also available. This college is good to study a medical course in Karimnagar. In our course, there is a total of 4 semesters, and 2 fests were organised during our tenure.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: Review about Sri Shivani institute of technology.

content.Placements: College administration is so good and they bring placement companies to the college every year. They give a chance for the final year students and third year students so that they can secure a job. There is also a placement cell in our campus. Our college also have campus recruitment training lecturers. They teach us every thing and train the students so that they can easily face the interviews that will happen in our college during campus placement.
content.Infrastructure: Our college infrastructure is so good. We have all the facilities here. We have good sanitary facility, water facility and accommodation. Boys and girls have hostels here. Warden is also present in hostel. Hostel food is also good here. We have Wi-Fi facility in our labs and in college and in hostel.

overview_faqs.question: Is KK University good for MBA?
overview_faqs.answer: Absolutely, KK University is good for MBA. It offers an MBA program that was approved by AICTE and recognized by UGC when it was founded in 2004. The fact that it has an NAAC "A" accreditation attests to the high caliber of instruction provided. It provides MBA programs with a range of specializations, including international business, marketing, finance, and human resources. The development of critical management abilities, including communication, leadership, and decision-making, is highly valued at the university. Good placements are the result of its solid industry partnerships; some of the main employers are ICICI, HDFC, Axis Bank, Flipkart, Paytm, and others.Course fees are reasonable when compared to more expensive B-schools. Scholarships come with a lot of options.Because it's in Bihar, students from eastern India can easily access it.

review_summary.college_name: KK University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Review of KK University.

content.Placements: About 70% of the students get placements from our course. In our college, the highest salary package offered is 4.5 LPA, while the lowest salary package offered is 2 LPA. Companies visit our college to select freshers to build their future. Big and small companies like Paytm, Tata, Wipro, etc., visit our college for placements.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities of our college include Wi-Fi facility with 35 MB high-speed. Labs are well developed, like they have the mechanical and civil engineering branch required machines, a computer lab with high technology, and an electronics lab. Classrooms are well-designed and divided into sections to provide a great learning experience.

individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Review of KK University.

content.Placements: Last year, the placement was not good. The highest package offered was 4 LPA, and the lowest package was 2.2 LPA. There is no placement cell. 5 to 6 percent of the students have been placed, and the average salary was 3.25 LPA. All the students have done their internships.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is too good, no doubt about it. The facilities provided are drinking water, a playing ground, a basketball court, a stage for program functions, a bank, and an ATM, all of which are available on our college campus. The bus facilities are also available. There are separate hostels for girls and boys. There is no Wi-Fi connection provided for the students, not even for the hostel students.

individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Review of KK University.

content.Placements: A total of 98% of students were placed in my course. The top recruiting companies are Tata, Mahindra, Lexus, Ford, etc. The top roles offered in my course are HR and Assistant Manager. The highest package is 6 LPA, and the lowest package is 3 LPA. A total of 95% of students got internships in my course at Tata Motors.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available in my course/department include full-speed Wi-Fi for official use only. Labs are big and well-cleaned, and classrooms are big and properly ventilated. The library is well-stocked with books. The quality of facilities available in my hostel is acceptable, and the quality of food in the mess and canteen is good. Medical and sports facilities are also available on campus.

individual_reviews.course: M.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Review of KK University.

content.Placements: Our placement cell is active throughout the year. They have a neatly designed website through which we can look for opportunities and apply to them. We are eligible for placements in our final year and are encouraged to start applying for opportunities right from the start of our final year. The roles and packages are good, but there is still scope for better placements compared to the North Campus colleges.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel fees are Rs. 5,000 per month and Rs.50,000 per year for neat rooms. There is an increase in cot facilities, and good network facilities are needed for the bathrooms. The hostel food menu is good, but the food quality is bad. The fees are affordable. They provide personal beds and study areas for students from other cities. There is a canteen for food, and students are charged monthly for the hostel. They receive their meals promptly.

individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Review of KK University.

content.Placements: The most attractive thing about the university is its high-paying packages in companies like Infosys, Wipro, and other highly reputable companies. The placements in our colleges are not like a piece of cake belonging to some particular students. It is accessible to all the students equally.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure and the environment on the campus are highly satisfying and are good for a student to concentrate well. The rooms are very well ventilated, and they have an accurate temperature in both summer and winter. The students at the university take pride in telling others about their campus.

admission_overview.college_name: KK University Admission 2025: Courses and Fees, Eligibility, Selection and Application Forms

admission_process.title: KK University Admission Process 2024

paragraphs: KK University admissionto all professional and technical courses is based on the performance of the candidate in theKK University entrance exam. However, for some courses, the admission criteria are merit-based. Candidates willing to take admission toKK University coursesare required to meet the eligibility criteria of their desired course and then fill out the application form before the deadline.

KK Universityoffers more than twenty-five courses through its ten constituent schools. The courses are offered at undergraduate, postgraduate and diploma levels in multiple streams such as commerce and management, engineering and technology, arts, etc.

KK University course eligibility criteriarequire candidates to have at least twelve years of school education for admission. However, the eligibility is also based on the level of the course. Studnets can check some of the eligibility and selection criteria forKK University courses:
Class 12 in PCM with a minimum of 45% marks (40% for reserved categories)

To secure their seats in KK University, candidates are required to pay the fees mentioned below. The fees includes various components such as caution money, alumni fees, university enrollment fees, etc. TheKKU fees and seatsfor the academic year 2024:
Students can check the KK University dmission procedure mentioned below:
1- KK University Application Process
Contenders seeking admission to the KK University courses must fill out the Application Form. Submit the form to the Officer in Charge (Admission) of the University before the deadline.
The application will be examined by the Admission Counsellor, followed by approval from the respective Faculty Dean/Principal.
2- KK University Selection Criteria
KK University admission criteria is based on merit and may include an Admission/ Entrance Test and a personal interview, as well as verification of all original documents.
Certain programmes may have specific eligibility criteria based on qualifying examination/test pass percentages.
3- Admission Confirmation
Students must provide a Transfer Certificate/Migration Certificate for admission to any programme.

faqs.question: Can I join KK University directly?
faqs.answer: Yes, anyone can enroll directly at KK University by just following the usual admissions process. In class 12, student who meet the minimal eligibility marks can apply directly to the university. Candidates can apply immediately through the online portal by visiting the university's official website, where the application forms are available.Based on the 12th standard grades, KK University does provide direct admission for the majority of undergraduate programs, including BA, BSc, BCom, etc. There is no entrance exam necessary.You need a valid JEE Main score to apply for a BTech. BTech programs do not offer direct admission based on 12th grade grades.On the basis of merit, postgraduate programs such as MA, MSc, and MCom provide direct admission to students of relevant undergraduate degrees.

reviews.review_heading: Review of KK University.
reviews.review_text: Facilities of our college include Wi-Fi facility with 35 MB high-speed. Labs are well developed, like they have the mechanical and civil engineering branch required machines, a computer lab with high technology, and an electronics lab. Classrooms are well-designed and divided into sections to provide a great learning experience.

reviews.review_heading: Review of KK University.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is too good, no doubt about it. The facilities provided are drinking water, a playing ground, a basketball court, a stage for program functions, a bank, and an ATM, all of which are available on our college campus. The bus facilities are also available. There are separate hostels for girls and boys. There is no Wi-Fi connection provided for the students, not even for the hostel students.

reviews.review_heading: Review of KK University.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available in my course/department include full-speed Wi-Fi for official use only. Labs are big and well-cleaned, and classrooms are big and properly ventilated. The library is well-stocked with books. The quality of facilities available in my hostel is acceptable, and the quality of food in the mess and canteen is good. Medical and sports facilities are also available on campus.

reviews.review_heading: Review of KK University.
reviews.review_text: Hostel fees are Rs. 5,000 per month and Rs.50,000 per year for neat rooms. There is an increase in cot facilities, and good network facilities are needed for the bathrooms. The hostel food menu is good, but the food quality is bad. The fees are affordable. They provide personal beds and study areas for students from other cities. There is a canteen for food, and students are charged monthly for the hostel. They receive their meals promptly.

reviews.review_heading: Review of KK University.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and the environment on the campus are highly satisfying and are good for a student to concentrate well. The rooms are very well ventilated, and they have an accurate temperature in both summer and winter. The students at the university take pride in telling others about their campus.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied and relevant because of faculty in our college and good placement in 2021.
reviews.review_text: In my college, there are awesome facilities available, such as Wi-Fi in every corner, labs available for practicals, and workshops available for mechanical students. In the hostel, there are separate lockers for every student, and the food in the mess is awesome. Many sports are available for both boys and girls, such as cricket, badminton, etc.

reviews.review_heading: You can admission in our college.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of our college is very good but no Wi-Fi available in college. Smart class is average the hostel is decorated good the mess faculty is also good. There is no library for students and there are many lacks of books. Cafeteria is also available in our college and food quality is very good.

reviews.review_heading: B.Sc. agriculture in my college.
reviews.review_text:
The infrastructure is well good. There is no Wi-Fi in our campus and smart classrooms are available and the hostel is well decorated and the mess faculty is pretty good. There is no library in our college for students. 
1 cafeteria is available in college.

reviews.review_heading: I am not satisfied with this college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good. There is no library for students and books are not available on time. There is no Wi-Fi in our college. Smart classrooms are good. The hostel is well-decorated. The mess facility is good. Canteen is available in our college.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college, but compared to the rest of the campus, management is not good.
reviews.review_text: Our college building, classrooms, laboratories, and other facilities were good, but when it comes to education, these facilities were not good. There was no proper management for fee structure, submitting fees, getting a degree, and mark sheets. They will make students run from here and there for no reason.

reviews.review_heading: This college is a private and newly established.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this college is good, but provided facilities in this college are not good. No Wi-Fi, laboratories are average, classrooms are also average, and the library is also average. In hostels, faculty members and students are live together so students can ask their doubts at any time. Food available in mess is average and sports and, games are good in this college.

reviews.review_heading: I am completely disappointed with this bad college.
reviews.review_text: There is no Wi-Fi facility. Labs are available only for checking purposes. Classrooms are mixed like mechanical and civil students are studying together with the same teacher in the same room. It serves very dirty food. There is no library, and it is only for representation. There are only staff members for medical purposes. Our college does not provide sports, and there are only fields full of grass.

reviews.review_heading: I suggest you not to take admission to this college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this college is very good. On this campus, you feel like you are in a very big college. Classrooms are also good, and there are all departments and all labs. The quality of the hostel provided is quite good, but the food served is not much good. A medical room is available, but there is no doctor. There is a big playground and a basketball court also.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, KK University is good.
reviews.review_text: The facilities provided in the hostel are good. It has a good water supply. The food is good. Campus facilities are average. The infrastructure is excellent. Buildings are very beautiful, and a garden is present. Lift facilities are not available. A waterfall is present.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the college, and it has good placements.
reviews.review_text: All the rooms are cleaned. Many teachers also stay in the hostel, so students get an opportunity to get to know about teachers and learn many things. Everything is much better in the hostel, and the food quality is very high. New gym facilities are provided to keep the students fit and fine.
